question: Annapurna Devi, who was awarded the Padma Bhushan, was a famous player of which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __Surbahar__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Annapurna Devi, the legendary musician awarded **Padma Bhushan in 1977**, was associated with **Surbahar** musical instrument.
 
• Indian Surbahar player Annapurna Devi was the daughter of **Ustad Allaudin Khan**.
 
• She married to famous "**Sitar Maestro**" **Pt. Ravi Shankar**.
 
• In 1991, she received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
 
• In 2004, she was made a fellow of the **Sangeet Natak Akademi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __**Annapurna Devi**__ 

 
• Born: 23 April 1927, Maihar, **Satna, Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• She was given the name 'Annapurna' by former Maharaja Brijnath Singh of the former Maihar Estate.
 
• Her students include many notable disciples including Hariprasad Chaurasia, Nityanand Haldipur, and Nikhil Banerjee.
